title: Security fix for GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964 applied in: miniforge3 26.7.2.1-r0
description: A high-severity security vulnerability affects the miniforge3 package versions prior to 26.7.2.1-r0. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes a significant availability impact. The issue has been resolved in version 26.7.2.1-r0.
